name: Space Worlds 01 : Poetic 1 - Z Image Turbo
description: Finding all my models or profile elsewhere than Civitai is without my consent ! Please don't repost my files. Send people to my Civitai profile, thanks :) -- Ok I made these versions JUST FOR FUN ... Because the first one of this serie... was uh special ? The first illustrious and xl versions were somekind of a challenge to work with. Stuck view angle, ugly, same style, same colors, lack of flexibility... But many achieved to do nice pics and I was so surprised ^^ So I wanted to do the same here... to give you a hard time :P But this is Z Image, it's fighting all the lack of flexibility, the stuck view isn't stuck anymore ! Grrrr !!! ^^ These versions are FOR FUN AND TESTING !!! -- So yes there are and will be other versions ! Grrrrr !!! ^^ -- V1 ORIGINS : Let's start with the most ugly and stuck version. Those who like to have a hard time will keep the strength at 1. Others who want "more" flexibility will use 0.7 -- HOW TO USE : Strength : 0.7 to 1 tested Steps : 15 tested Checkpoints : Any but I mostly used the Base Fp8 and Base BF16 models. Adetailer : not used, your choice Sampler : Tested with EULER Scheduler : NORMAL -- Main trigger word : sw01p_zit -- EFFECTS : Heh no effects ! This was one of my early loras. Effects came much later ^^ -- V1-2 : Better version, much more flexible :) -- HOW TO USE : Strength : 1 tested Steps : 15 tested Checkpoints : Any but I mostly used the Base Fp8 and Base BF16 models. Adetailer : not used, your choice Sampler : Tested with EULER Scheduler : NORMAL -- Main trigger word : sw01p_xl -- Sorry about the trigger word, I was in a hurry before going away for the holidays and i took the SDXL trigger word by error. ^^ -- Have fun ^^
